title: TO BROIL A STEAK
instructions: Have your gridiron hot. Wipe the steak clean. Put it in a dish with melted butter, and then put on the hot gridiron and broil ten minutes. Turn it twice, and season with salt,  pepper and butter. --"UNCLE JOHN," S.C.
